text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty, today's the day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I've finished my train'n, so now all I gotta
do is go back t'camp, grab
my wallet,
and...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ask my trainer out on a d-d-da... da...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-ask them to go to the festival with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin stands her ground, as if
bracing for battle. Just as her
intensity
begins to feel suffocating, she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um... Uh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: INHALE! EXHALE!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: W-would you... Would yooouuu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: GO TO THE FESTIVAL WITH ME?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Yes! I did it! I asked my trainer out! For
realsies!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Now it's fin'lly over—Wait! Don't get
ahead of yourself, Yukino! Not
till you get
an answer...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thanks oodles! At last... Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin beams with joy. She looks like
she's about to start
dancing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment prior, she looked like she
was about to explode... She
must really
want to go to this festival.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, fiddlesticks! Who knew the ring toss
would be so diff'cult!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I thought f'sure I'd be able t'show off at a
little festival like this, but
maybe not...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Guess I'm no closer to being a city girl
than I was before... But still...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Hear'n my trainer cheer me on makes me
smile...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(My heart's all fluttery, and I'm hav'n a
blast! But I keep think'n... is
this okay?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm still so far from the glitz and glam of a
city girl...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...No, that's enough of that doom'n and
gloom'n! Right now, I gotta
focus on
show'n my trainer how grateful I am!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(And I can't thank 'em with a frown on my
face...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A real city girl wouldn't do that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(City girls are always look'n forward with a
conf'dent smile. They don't
need
trends—they shine on their own.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (That's how I wanna be...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's go over there next! They're doing a
candy cutt'n game!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's it... One step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's eyes glimmer with
excitement as she runs up to the next
stall.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowie, that sure was a hopp'n good time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met you, ev'ry day's been a
real treat!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even before you were my trainer, you
taught me all sort of stuff, and
I'm still
learn'n so much from you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I invited you t'day... I wanted
t'show you how much you've
helped me
grow, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin looks down and shifts a little
out of embarrassment
before continuing
on. It seems like she's wanted to say this
for some
time now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It didn't go... 'xactly as planned. Still, I'm
glad I finally managed t'ask
you out on a
date!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Turns out I haven't grown much, 'specially
in terms of being a city girl,
but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everyth'n you've done! I'm
so glad you're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew! I finally said it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm slightly confused about what she thinks
a "date" is, but... it's clear
she's worked
hard to show her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not quite a "city girl" yet, but her
growth as a racer and a person
is shown in
her can-do attitude.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-thanks for say'n that. Hehe, I sure did
luck out when I got such a
swell trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not the most conf'dent person...
But hopefully one day I'll
change, even
just a teensy bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she doesn't completely
believe she's changed. Surely
there must
be some way to prove her growth to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino perks up in surprise, but she
clearly remembers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lipstick Gold City endorsed... At the
time, she avoided buying it,
but now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I've been thinkin' of giv'n it a go. D'you
think you could come with
me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Then we're off to the races! I'll find
my perfect color... someth'n
glitzy and
glam'rous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether that little lipstick is actually
proof of her growth is anyone's
guess, but
at least to Yukino Bijin, it's a long-awaited
step toward her
dream.
